acceptance_mapping.statement: Compression must not remove constraints, uncertainty, contradictions, provenance, or authority boundaries material to the named objective.
Every analogy must declare what maps, what does not map, and when reliance on the analogy becomes unsafe.
A framing is valid only for its named consumer, objective, context, source epoch, and expiry condition.
The consumer may move from a compact framing to its supporting detail without changing the underlying claim or hiding residue.
A framing, analogy, fit assessment, or user preference cannot grant authority or permit an effect.
